```yaml
name: Promote RC to Stable

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_tag:
        description: 'RC tag to promote (e.g., v3.0.0-rc5)'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      rc_tag: ${{ steps.set_rc.outputs.rc_tag }}
      stable_tag: ${{ steps.set_stable.outputs.stable_tag }}
      commit_sha: ${{ steps.get_sha.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set RC tag
        id: set_rc
        run: echo "rc_tag=${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Compute stable tag
        id: set_stable
        run: |
          rc=${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          stable=${rc/-rc[0-9]*/}
          echo "stable_tag=$stable" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get commit SHA of RC tag
        id: get_sha
        run: |
          sha=$(git rev-parse ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }})
          echo "sha=$sha" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Validate RC tag exists
        run: |
          if ! git rev-parse --verify ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "RC tag ${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} does not exist."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate stable tag does not exist
        run: |
          if git rev-parse --verify ${{ steps.set_stable.outputs.stable_tag }} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Stable tag ${{ steps.set_stable.outputs.stable_tag }} already exists."
            exit 1
          fi

  promote:
    needs: validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set variables
        id: vars
        run: |
          rc=${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          stable=${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          echo "rc=$rc" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "stable=$stable" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create stable git tag
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git tag -a ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} -m "Promote ${{ needs.validate.outputs.rc_tag }} to stable" ${{ needs.validate.outputs.commit_sha }}
          git push origin ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}

      - name: Retag Docker images
        run: |
          docker login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} -p ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          for image in grafana/beyla grafana/beyla-k8s-cache; do
            docker buildx imagetools create ghcr.io/$image:${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }} --tag ghcr.io/$image:${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          done

      - name: Create stable GitHub release
        run: |
          gh release create ${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }} --generate-notes --title "v${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}" --repo ${{ github.repository }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Copy assets from RC release to stable release
        run: |
          rc_tag=${{ github.event.inputs.rc_tag }}
          stable_tag=${{ needs.validate.outputs.stable_tag }}
          rc_release_id=$(gh release view $rc_tag --json id --jq .id)
          assets=$(gh release view $rc_tag --json assets --jq '.assets[] | .url')
          for asset_url in $assets; do
            asset_name=$(basename $(echo $asset_url | cut -d'?' -f1))
            curl -L -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" -o $asset_name $asset_url
            gh release upload $stable_tag $asset_name
          done
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Add promotion checklist to summary
        run: |
          echo "## Promotion Checklist" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Helm chart updated and published" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "- Technical documentation updated" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
```
